ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached waveform shows one period from 0 to 2π. In the first half-cycle, the output is zero for a gap after 0, then rises to a rectangular positive level marked 1 for a conduction width α, then returns to zero before π. In the second half-cycle, there is an identical rectangular negative pulse at level −1, with zero-voltage gaps, giving half-wave symmetry. Reasoning: Following the indicated waveform, take the positive pulse of width α as centered in the first half-cycle. The blanking angle on each side is β = (π − α)/2. With half-wave symmetry, the fundamental sine coefficient is b1 = (2/π)∫ from β to π−β of sinθ dθ. Evaluating the integral gives b1 = (2/π)[−cosθ]β^(π−β) = (4/π)cosβ = (4/π)sin(α/2). The rms value of the fundamental component is V1,rms = b1/√2 = (4/(π√2))sin(α/2). For α = 120°, sin(60°) = 0.866, so V1,rms = (4/(π√2))×0.866 ≈ 0.78 V.

method.method_draft: From the figure, interpret the waveform as a normalized single-pulse inverter output: each half-cycle conducts for α at amplitude ±1 and is off for the remaining part. Convert the given conduction angle to the corresponding switching/blanking angle δ=(180°−α)/2. With α=120°, δ=30°. Apply the standard single-pulse inverter formula V1,rms=(2√2/π)Vdc cosδ with Vdc=1 from the plotted amplitude scale, yielding about 0.78 V.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中给出一个周期为 2π 的矩形阶梯输出电压波形。正半周中有一段幅值为 +1 的脉冲，脉冲宽度标为导通角 α；其余部分为 0。负半周中有一段幅值为 -1 的脉冲，形状与正半周对应，之后回到 0。横轴标出了 0、π、2π。
推理：按图中归一化幅值，取 Vdc = 1。单脉冲逆变器每半周导通角为 α，空白角为 δ = (180° − α)/2。给定 α = 120°，所以 δ = (180° − 120°)/2 = 30°。采用标准单脉冲逆变器基波 rms 值公式：V1,rms = (2√2/π) Vdc cosδ。代入 Vdc = 1、δ = 30°，得 V1,rms = (2√2/π) × cos30° ≈ 0.9003 × 0.8660 ≈ 0.7797 V，约为 0.78 V。
